name: re-octroi-producer-registration-and-returns
description: Réunion octroi de mer reference for local producers in 2026. Covers production turnover, the inclusive threshold, partial-year adjustment, following-year liability, customs identification, quarterly nil returns, invoice details and separate accounting. Distinguishes the producer threshold from import taxation and total business turnover. Preserves the original threshold cases, uses the national circular with bounded current-law checks, and separates the February production-definition amendment from the July rate-decision amendment. Current tariffs, exemptions, filing screens and detailed tax computations remain on hold. This source-cited draft has no professional approval and is not a complete Réunion tax pack.
